facts.business: Umiya Mobile Limited is a multi-brand retail company specializing in the sale of smartphones, mobile accessories, and consumer durable electronic products through a network of owned and franchise stores.
key_risks: Intense competition from e-commerce platforms, brand-owned stores, and quick-commerce businesses
Rapid technological changes leading to product obsolescence and inventory discounts
Dependence on vendor relationships for product availability and credit terms
Need for competitive pricing while protecting margins
